cmd:
nohup bash -c '
{ echo "=== / top-level (x) ==="; du -xh --max-depth=1 / 2>/dev/null | sort -rh | head -20
echo "=== /opt/weather-pipeline ==="; du -h --max-depth=1 /opt/weather-pipeline 2>/dev/null | sort -rh | head -15
echo "=== /opt/weather-pipeline/* depth2 top ==="; du -h --max-depth=2 /opt/weather-pipeline 2>/dev/null | sort -rh | head -25
echo "=== /var ==="; du -xh --max-depth=2 /var 2>/dev/null | sort -rh | head -12
echo "=== /usr /home /root /snap /tmp ==="; du -xsh /usr /home /root /snap /tmp /swapfile 2>/dev/null
echo "=== journal ==="; journalctl --disk-usage 2>/dev/null
echo "=== docker ==="; (docker system df 2>/dev/null || echo no-docker)
echo "=== DONE ==="; } > /tmp/du_report.txt 2>&1' >/dev/null 2>&1 &
echo started
